This is a list of notable '''automotive fuel retailers''' ("[[petrol]]" or "[[gasoline]]", "[[Diesel fuel|diesel]]", etc.) and their controlling oil companies.
The format of this page is based on current ownership and where they largely operate:

* Parent company
** Children (acquired companies and notable brands)
